carbon.$description: Carbon — Body text, footer background, heading text on light surfaces — the near-black structural anchor

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Page canvas, header background, inverted text on dark footer

concrete.$description: Concrete — Muted helper text and secondary dividers on white surfaces, secondary text on dark footer

fog.$description: Fog — Alternate surface band, subtle card background where a step up from pure white is needed

bmwtypenextlatin.$description: Workhorse type family — 400 for body copy and nav links, 700 for inline emphasis and section labels, 900 reserved for brand wordmarks. Compact leading (1.20–1.30) on headings, generous (1.60+) on body. Custom typeface with squared geometric forms; substitute with Inter or Neue Haas Grotesk for close fidelity.

bmwtypenextlatin-light.$description: Display heading only — the 300 weight at 60px is the brand's anti-convention signature; it whispers rather than shouts, signaling premium through restraint. Used exclusively for the largest section title per page. Do not reuse for anything below 40px.
